subject: Information Theory
title: White Noise
description: A quick, practical guide to White Noise.

hook.text: Turn on an old TV between channels. That static hiss contains every frequency in equal measure. That's white noise.

buildup.text: White noise has a flat power spectrum: every frequency contributes equally. It's the most random possible noise.

discovery.text: Shannon used white noise as the worst-case model. If your system works against white noise, it works against anything.

twist.text: Real noise is rarely white. Atmospheric noise, interference, and fading create colored noise with specific patterns.

climax.text: White noise is the theoretical baseline. It makes math tractable and gives conservative performance guarantees.

punchline.text: Every frequency, equal power. The purest chaos.
